content.rationale: The show verb: for each id argument it parses the id (M-store-path), resolves it the way edge targets resolve (M-node-resolve, hence M-node-load), and emits O8's rendering — the loaded document as pretty JSON, one output per valid node; an id that resolves to the root emits the root marker (O8-root) in place of a document, and an id that maps to neither refuses naming it (M-refusal); a bare `deccy show` with no id refuses. It reads through M-node-resolve, whose read reaches M-store-read through the runner (M-jj), and changes nothing; it carries its own --help text and branch (xlvoxmyl/rwlywqrk, per M-help's division of labour), receives the injected context (M-context-injection), and returns its lines for the envelope to write (M-output-return) under M-route's handler shape. I1-serde (`orrvsxqq`) fixes the JSON layer the module is written against — serde and serde_json, the crate's own `Value` and the derive. It takes the runner from the injected context (M-context). The invocation that reads the node produces the refusal — the read or the resolve (S2-read-refusal-site, vollyzvn): an id whose document cannot be read refuses, naming it.
